Building Character, Community and Lasting Friendships Since 1991 Summer’s Edge Day Camp/Tennis School in Lexington, where building character and community is just as important as learning how to swim. Campers from 4 to 14 years old unplug to explore 35 acres of woods and discover the meaning of character and friendship.
